name: Is it normal to be down bad for my friend?
source:
Hana has a crush on her beautiful friend. When they decide to live together, Hana wonders if she'd be able to survive.  

A simple GL about a girl who's whipped for her best friend.

[From [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/is-it-normal-to-be-down-bad-for-my-friend]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
花喜歡上了漂亮的朋友。兩人決定同居時，花忍不住想，自己真的撐得住嗎？

一個簡單的百合故事，講的是一位對自己最好的朋友著迷到言聽計從的女孩。
